name: io.github.tonyyang0504/upwork-mcp
description: Upwork (deals): me, search_postings, get_posting, bid_status, list_messages, send_message. Every too

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_UPWORK_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of an approved Upwork API key (apply at https://www.upwork.com/developer/keys/apply; Upwork reviews every key).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_UPWORK_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of the same API key (form body of the refresh_token grant).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_UPWORK_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from the Authorization Code Grant for the freelancer/agency account; the runtime mints access tokens (TTL 86400 s) at https://www.upwork.com/api/v3/oauth2/token and keeps the rotated refresh_token each response returns (set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to persist it).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_UPWORK_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional organization id sent as X-Upwork-API-TenantId (the execution context; without it the user's default organization is used).
